haproxy-1-t2.haproxy_config:
global
    nbthread 2
    maxconn 4096
    stats socket /tmp/bkr-haproxy-jqas1c9_/stats.sock mode 600 level admin

defaults
    mode tcp
    timeout connect 5s
    timeout client 30s
    timeout server 30s

frontend incoming
    bind 127.0.0.1:64722
    default_backend bkr

backend bkr
    balance roundrobin
    server worker1 127.0.0.1:64723
